title: Compiler stage ledger
description: A construction run's own record of compiler-construction stages (merlin.compiler_stage_ledger.v1). Stage ids are those declared in merlin/contract/compiler_stages.yaml. Execution and progress bookkeeping only: it grants no qualification, grade or promotion. A metric that was not measured is absent, never 0.

updated_ns.description: When the writer last updated the ledger (epoch nanoseconds).

stage.description: A stage or lane id from compiler_stages.yaml.

agent_thread_ids.description: Agent threads whose work is attributed to this stage.

capsules_gated.description: Capsules whose obligations this stage must discharge.

metrics.description: Stage-specific measured values, named as in compiler_stages.yaml.
